osPackages.checkValidUntil: disabled source-scoped (Check-Valid-Until: no) on both fixed snapshot sources only, as Debian documents for historical snapshots. HONEST RATIONALE: at build time on 2026-10-09 the trixie-security Release Valid-Until (2026-10-15T23:02:22Z) has NOT yet expired; the directive is retained because the fixed snapshot is a historical artifact used after its validity window and signature verification stays enabled.
osPackages.scopedCaBootstrap: the upstream node:trixie-slim image ships without ca-certificates; apt bootstraps ca-certificates=20250419 over HTTP from the same fixed signed snapshot, then both sources switch to HTTPS with normal CA verification. No trusted=yes, no AllowUnauthenticated, no TLS bypass, no mutable latest/snapshot-less suite.
